examples.en: For administrative purposes, it was very inconvenient to have years of different lengths.
examples.zh: 就管理而言，年份长度不同很不方便。

examples.en: People still found coins inconvenient to carry, when they wanted to buy something expensive.
examples.zh: 当人们想要买贵重物品时，仍然觉得携带硬币不方便。

examples.en: "It's no disgrace to be colored," the black entertainer Bert Williams famously observed early in the century, "but it is awfully inconvenient."
examples.zh: 黑人表演者伯特·威廉姆斯在本世纪初提出了一条著名的观点：“作为有色人种并不丢脸，但是极其不方便。”
